intro.text: Guests and C R M is the part of the Front office menu that holds what the system knows about a person, rather than a booking. In this video you will see its screens, and who uses which.

line.text: Guests lists everyone booked at this hotel, one line per name, with their stays, what they spent and what they owe.
Companies and agents shows where the bookings came from, and what each source was worth. Add company is here too.
Guest messages shows what the system sent to guests, and whether it went. Messages that guests write to the desk wait here too.
Reviews asks a guest who has left for a review, and shows who was asked.
Guest 360 shows one guest across every hotel of the group. Only the owner, an Admin and the GM see it.
Possible same person lists guest records that share a phone number or an email. The same three people join them, or keep them apart.
Reception's own menu shows Guests and Guest messages. Companies and agents, and Reviews, are reached with Find a screen.
Which messages go out by themselves is switched on or off in Settings, under Messages.

outro.text: You see the screens your role may open. The next videos take each one step by step.

videos.title: The guest list

intro.text: In this video you will read the Guests screen: everyone booked at this hotel, one line per name.

line.text: Open Guests, under Guests and C R M. The pill beside the heading counts the guests.
Each line is put together from the bookings, by the name typed on them. Repeat guests come first.
Stays and Nights count every booking under the name, cancelled and future ones too. Last stay says when the last stay ended, or first visit.
Booked via lists every source their stays came through. Total spend is what their stays were charged.
Balance is what they still owe, in red, or what they are owed, in blue. A dash means nothing.
To find someone, type part of their name here. The search finds names only.
This yellow box counts the names whose stays overlap. One person cannot be in two rooms on the same night.
So a name marked overlapping stays is two people sharing a name, or something entered twice. It is shown, never merged.
A row does not open. To correct a guest, use Edit guest on their booking.

outro.text: The guest list goes by the name typed. To tell one person from another, the system uses the phone and email instead.

videos.next: A guest's record: the marks and Edit guest

videos.title: A guest's record: the marks and Edit guest

intro.text: A guest's own record belongs to the person, not to one booking. In this video you will mark a guest, and correct their record, from a booking's panel.

line.text: Open the booking from Arrivals, In house or All bookings. The marks sit on the line under the guest's name.
Mark V I P makes the guest a V I P, on this visit and the next. Where the group has V I P levels, choose which.
Tick Agreed to WhatsApp only when the guest says yes. The voucher goes on WhatsApp only with this tick and a phone number.
Guest 360 opens the guest's whole history. Only the owner, an Admin and the GM have it.
A guest who has stayed with the group before carries a blue mark, such as Stayed with the group 3 times. The desk is shown nothing more.
To correct the guest, tap Edit guest.
This is the guest's own record: the same on every booking of theirs, at every hotel. Change what is wrong, such as the name.
Or the phone and email. Messages go to them from then on.
Nationality is two letters: I N for India. Anything else puts the guest on the Form three register.
Save stays grey until something has changed and everything typed is right. The message says Guest updated.

outro.text: Every change is kept in the audit log. Only the owner, an Admin, the GM, the Hotel Manager and Reception see Edit guest, Mark V I P and the WhatsApp tick.

intro.text: Companies and agents answers one question: where did the business come from, and what was each source worth?

line.text: Three tiles sit at the top. Through an agent is the revenue from the booking sites, and its share of the whole.
Direct is the revenue that came straight to the property.
Owed to the property adds up what every source still owes.
Then one table for each kind. Travel agents are booked through a channel, and charged a commission for it.
Each table shows bookings, room nights, revenue, commission and what is owed. Commission prints as a dash: it is charged outside this system today.
To add a company, tap Add company.
It is one record for the group: the same company at every hotel. Type its name.
Choose its kind: Corporate or Travel agent.
Type its G S T I N from the company's G S T certificate. It prints on the company's tax invoices.
If the company may pay later, switch on Credit allowed, and type the credit days and the limit.
Add company stays grey until the form is right. The message says Company added.

outro.text: Reception gets a shorter window: the name, G S T I N and address only. Credit is set by the owner, an Admin or the GM.

intro.text: Guest 360 is for the owner, an Admin and the GM. It shows one person across every hotel of the group.

line.text: Open Guest 360. Type two letters of a name, or a whole phone number or email.
Each guest record found is a row, with its phone and email. A dash means none.
The row says how many times they stayed with the group. Tap it to open the guest.
Who they are: the name, V I P or Blacklisted, phone and email, nationality, and whether an I D is on file. The I D itself is never shown.
Edit guest corrects the record here too.
What they are worth: visits, nights, what they were charged, and their first and last stay. Visits counts the times they checked in.
Every stay, at every hotel, lists each booking with its dates, room type, source, status and charge.
Loyalty shows their points, or says they are not a member.
What was sent to them lists every message, from any hotel.
To blacklist a guest, type the reason and tap Blacklist. The desk is shown the reason when they book again. It warns; it never refuses.
Offers says whether offers may be sent to them. Record their yes, or Record no offers, shows when the record has a phone or an email.

outro.text: Clear the blacklist takes a blacklist off. And no offers go to a guest who has not said yes.

intro.text: A guest is one record for the whole group. The system knows a returning guest by an exact phone number or email, never by a name, and a person always confirms.

line.text: On New booking, type the guest's phone or email.
If it matches a guest on file, a grey box asks: same person? Ask the guest. If it is them, tap Same person, and the booking goes on their record.
Not them? Do nothing, or tap Not them to undo your choice. The booking then makes a new guest record.
While you are here, ask about WhatsApp. Tick Guest agreed to WhatsApp only with their yes.
Older bookings made a new record each time. Possible same person lists every two records that share a phone number or an email.
Each card says what the two share.
If they are one person, tap Keep this record on the one whose name, phone and email should stand. It now reads This record stands.
Read the strip, and tap Join into one. The stays move; nothing is deleted.
A family on one mobile is two people. Tap Not the same person, and the pair is not listed again.
Every join is listed under Joined, with Undo. Not the same person answers are listed the same way.

outro.text: When unsure, do not join. A wrong join is worse than a missed one.

videos.title: What goes out to guests

intro.text: The system sends a guest only a few messages. In this video you will see which, when, and the desk's own buttons.

line.text: The booking voucher is the confirmation. It goes once, when a booking is confirmed: by email where there is an address, and on WhatsApp where the booking is ticked and has a phone.
While online check-in is on, the voucher carries the guest's own check-in link and a Q R code.
The tax invoice goes by email, with its P D F, only once this is switched on.
The review request goes when a clerk asks, after check-out. It is off until switched on.
A booking made before sending was first switched on is confirmed only from nine in the morning to nine at night, the hotel's time.
These switches are for the owner, an Admin and the GM, for this hotel only. Nothing here sends anything.
WhatsApp needs the guest's yes. Unticked, messages go by email if there is one, else not at all.
View voucher opens the P D F to print or save, and sends nothing. It is under More options on a booking's panel.
After a booking is made, Send voucher and Send check-in link send it now. Until sending is set up, they are grey, with this same sentence.

outro.text: There is no day-before reminder. The voucher is the confirmation, sent once.

videos.next: Guest messages: did the guest get it?

videos.title: Guest messages: did the guest get it?

intro.text: Guest messages answers the question: did the guest get their voucher? It is a record. Nothing on it sends.

line.text: Open Guest messages, under Guests and C R M. Reception has it in its own menu.
While sending is not set up, a yellow notice says so, and why.
Next come the bookings no message can reach. Nothing was tried for them, so nothing failed, and they show nowhere else.
Each says what is missing. No telephone number and no email address: ask the guest, and add an email with Edit guest, or a phone and the WhatsApp tick if they agree.
Not agreed to WhatsApp, and no email address: ask whether WhatsApp is all right. If yes, tick it. If not, add an email.
The same screen for one booking reads What this system sent about this booking.
An empty record says which is true. Here, nothing has been sent, because nothing can be yet. That is not a fault.
Once messages go, each is a row: when, what, the booking, where it went, its state, who sent it, and what came back.
Delivered to the sender, in green, means the sending service took it. It does not mean the guest has read it.
Did not go, in red: the voucher is tried again a minute later, up to three times each way. Then hand the guest the voucher from View voucher, and tell the manager.
When guests have written to the desk, their messages come first. Reply opens that booking's messages, and the guest reads your reply on their page. Or tap Mark handled.

outro.text: Never tick Agreed to WhatsApp to make a message go. The tick is the guest's yes.

videos.next: Asking a guest for a review

videos.title: Asking a guest for a review

intro.text: Reviews asks a guest who has left for a review, and shows who was asked. Reviews themselves are not read in from Google or the booking sites.

line.text: Nothing can be sent until sending is set up. Here, it is not yet.
This property sends shows the hotel's review link. A dash means none has been set.
The owner or an Admin pastes the hotel's own Google review link, a full web address, and taps Save the link.
Departures lists the guests who left in the last 30 days, and whether each was asked. A dash means not asked yet.
To ask, tap WhatsApp or Email on the guest's row. WhatsApp is grey when the guest has no phone, Email when there is no email address.
The row then reads Asked, with the time, or Did not go, with the reason.
The buttons appear only when the hotel has a link, sending is set up, and your role may ask.
A group is asked once, at its lead guest's room.

outro.text: A guest is asked only after check-out, and only while the hotel's Review request switch is on.

intro.text: Here is the chapter in short: what to do, and when.

checklist.text: Taking a booking: type the phone and email. If same person appears, ask, and tap Same person if so.
Ask about WhatsApp and offers, and tick them only with a yes.
A name, phone or email is wrong: the booking's panel, Edit guest, Save.
Did my voucher come? Guest messages: find the booking's reference, then read State and What came back.
A booking no message can reach: add an email, or tick WhatsApp with the guest's yes.
A message from a guest: Guest messages. Reply, or Mark handled.
A new company at the desk: Companies and agents, Add company.
A guest has left: Reviews, then WhatsApp or Email on their row.
Managers, now and then: Possible same person, to join or keep apart. Guest 360, for the blacklist and offers.

outro.text: That is guests and guest messages. Thank you for watching.
